en_title: GTA 6 Switches Sprint to L3, Saving Thumbs Globally
cn_title: 《GTA6》将冲刺切换至L3，拯救全球玩家的拇指
opus_summary: 《GTA6》将默认冲刺操作改为按下左摇杆L3，玩家也可切换回经典控制方案。游戏启动时会提示这一变化；在健身房使用跑步机时，仍需按节奏反复点击X或A键。

paragraphs.en: Ever since Grand Theft Auto made the switch to 3D space with 2001’s GTA 3 , players have had to make use of the X button on PlayStation or the A button on Xbox to sprint. Up until San Andreas , holding down the relevant face button would trigger sprint, but CJ’s story changed that to just meaning “run”, with a repeated tap introduced for a full-fledged sprint. It’s been that way ever since with Rockstar’s games, including most recently 2018’s Red Dead Redemption 2 , leaving sore thumbs globally at the end of long chase sequences.
paragraphs.cn: 自《侠盗猎车手》于2001年的《GTA 3》中转入3D空间以来，玩家就一直得使用PlayStation上的X键或XBOX上的A键来冲刺。在《San Andreas》之前，按住相应的面部按键就会触发冲刺，但CJ的故事将其改成了仅仅意味着「奔跑」，而连续点击则被引入用于进行完整冲刺。此后Rockstar的游戏一直沿用了这种方式，包括最近的2018年作品《荒野大镖客：救赎2》，导致全球玩家在漫长的追逐场面结束时都拇指酸痛。

paragraphs.en: Well now, with GTA 6 , everything has changed.
paragraphs.cn: 不过现在，随着《GTA6》的推出，一切都改变了。

paragraphs.en: Finally, Rockstar’s return to Vice City changes the default sprint button to a press of the left analog stick, with a click of L3 making both Jason and Lucia sprint easily. You get the sense that the developer knows what a big deal this is, too, with one of the very first screens you see when first booting up GTA 6 being a warning about this change, alongside a message letting you know you can revert back to a more classic control scheme if you like.
paragraphs.cn: 最终，Rockstar重返Vice City，将默认冲刺按键改成了按下左摇杆，点击L3即可让Jason和Lucia轻松冲刺。你也会感觉到，开发者知道这是一件多么重大的事情：首次启动《GTA6》时，你看到的最初几个画面之一就是关于这一改动的警告，旁边还有一条消息告诉你，如果愿意，可以恢复为更经典的控制方案。

paragraphs.en: Interestingly, in a fun little easter egg of sorts, there is one instance you’ll have to run where the traditional button mapping does return. In a nod to the series’ past, if you use a treadmill at one of the map’s several gyms, the minigame asks you to repeatedly press down the X/A button at the correct rhythm to score as high as possible. So, if you fancy getting either of the protagonists in great shape, you’ll also be giving your thumb a workout at the same time.
paragraphs.cn: 有趣的是，在某种意义上作为一个有趣的小彩蛋，有一个你必须奔跑的场合会恢复传统的按键映射。作为对该系列过去的致意，如果你在地图上几家健身房中的某一家使用跑步机，这个小游戏会要求你按照正确的节奏反复按下X/A键，以尽可能取得高分。所以，如果你想让两位主角中的任意一位练出好身材，你的拇指也会同时得到锻炼。

paragraphs.en: Rockstar’s control schemes have long been a bone of contention for many fans, with RDR2’s in particular feeling unwieldy to some. Many unfortunate NPCs in the Wild West fell victim to accidental trigger pulls when all Arthur wanted to do was greet them with a pull of the left trigger and a button press. Although GTA 6 uses a similar communication system with the population of its world, thankfully pulling out a gun in public is a much more deliberate act in Leonida, and I’m happy to report I’ve not shot the face off of someone yet when all I wanted to do was say hello in over 100 hours so far.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar的控制方案长期以来一直是许多粉丝争论的焦点，其中RDR2的控制方式尤其让一些人觉得笨拙。当Arthur只是想通过扣下左扳机并按下一个按键来向他们打招呼时，许多不幸的西部世界NPC却成为了意外扣动扳机的受害者。尽管《GTA6》对其世界中的居民采用了类似的交流系统，但值得庆幸的是，在Leonida当众掏枪是一种更加刻意的行为；我很高兴地报告说，截至目前超过100小时的游戏时间里，我还没有在只想打招呼时把某人的脸轰掉。

paragraphs.en: Although I grew up playing in Rockstar’s open worlds, and am thoroughly used to the old-school way of having to sprint, I’d be lying if I didn’t massively prefer this new L3 approach to toggling a faster run speed. For a studio that always feels at the forefront of moving game development forward whenever it releases a game, the repeated tapping of X always felt like a needless and stubbornly archaic button input to me. Thankfully, my thumbs were instead saved for all of the delights Vice City had in store for me.
paragraphs.cn: 尽管我是在Rockstar的开放世界中长大，也已经完全习惯了必须冲刺的老派方式，但如果说我并不非常偏爱这种通过L3切换更快奔跑速度的新方法，那就是在撒谎。对于一家每次发布游戏时都总让人觉得处于推动游戏开发向前发展的最前沿的工作室来说，反复点击X键对我而言始终像是一种不必要且顽固过时的按键输入。值得庆幸的是，我的拇指得以留给Vice City为我准备的所有乐趣。

paragraphs.en: Are you going to be using L3 to sprint or sticking with the classic Rockstar controls in GTA 6? Vote in the poll below and let us know in the comments why!
paragraphs.cn: 你会在《GTA6》中使用L3冲刺，还是坚持采用Rockstar的经典控制方式？请在下方投票，并在评论中告诉我们原因！

paragraphs.en: We’ve got plenty more GTA 6 for you here at IGN. You can check out our review , or head over to our launch live blog , where I’ll be doing my best to answer as many of your spoiler-free questions as you may have about the game.
paragraphs.cn: IGN这里还有更多《GTA6》的内容供你阅读。你可以查看我们的评测，或者前往我们的发售直播博客；在那里，我会尽力回答你可能对这款游戏抱有的、且不涉及剧透的问题。
